title: A King Will Reign in Righteousness

questions.question: Behold, a king will reign in righteousness, and princes will rule in what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 32:1 (ESV): "and princes will rule in justice."

questions.question: Each will be like a hiding place from the wind, a shelter from the what?
Like streams of water in a dry place, like the shade of a great rock in a what land?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 32:2 (ESV): "like the shade of a great rock in a weary land."

questions.question: Then the eyes of those who see will not be closed, and the ears of those who hear will give what?
The heart of the hasty will understand and know, and the tongue of the stammerers will hasten to speak how?
The fool will no more be called noble, nor the scoundrel said to be what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 32:5 (ESV): "nor the scoundrel said to be honorable."

questions.question: For the fool speaks folly, and his heart is busy with what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 32:6 (ESV): "and his heart is busy with iniquity,"

questions.question: To practice ungodliness, to utter error concerning the LORD, to leave the craving of the hungry what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 32:6 (ESV): "to leave the craving of the hungry unsatisfied,"

questions.question: Rise up, you women who are at ease, hear my voice; you complacent daughters, give ear to my what?
In little more than a year you will shudder, you complacent women; for the grape harvest fails, the fruit harvest will not what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 32:10 (ESV): "the fruit harvest will not come."

questions.question: Until the Spirit is poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 32:15 (ESV): "and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field,"

questions.question: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness abide in the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 32:16 (ESV): "and righteousness abide in the fruitful field."

questions.question: And the effect of righteousness will be peace, and the result of righteousness, quietness and trust for how long?
My people will abide in a peaceful habitation, in secure dwellings, and in quiet what?
And it will hail when the forest falls down, and the city will be utterly laid what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 32:19 (ESV): "and the city will be utterly laid low."

key_verse_text: And the effect of righteousness will be peace, and the result of righteousness, quietness and trust forever.
